title: Uwo Yakuwemwo n’Ikigeragezo c’Amazi
intro: Mu bitabu vy’ivya kera vy’ivyanditswe vya kera, hariho umuntu ateye umunezero inkuru yiwe itatangura n’igitangaro gitangaje canke ihishurirwa ry’inkuba, ahubwo itangura n’ikigeragezo coroshe ariko gikomeye c’ukwizera. Ihanga ryari rihagaze ku nzira y’amasanganzira, rirondera ubuyobozi buva ku Mana kugira ngo ribe uburongozi. Ivyabaye vyari ikigeragezo c’ubwenge cane ku buryo cohishura abemera nyakuri bari muri bo. Woba ushobora gusobanura iyo nkuru y’akabanga ukoresheje ibimenyetso vyasigaye?
clues: Navuye mu muryango abantu bashima, kandi Allah yantoye kubera intumbero nyeranda batashobora gutahura.
Umubiri wanje wari ufise ikimenyetso c’itandukaniro abandi batagira, kikantuma mpagarara uwundi mu bantu banje.
Igihe uruzi rwamenyeshwa ko ari rwo kigeragezo, benshi barasubira inyuma—ariko jewe narateye imbere, nsunikwa n’ukwizera kudahungabana kw’isezerano rya Allah.
Nategetswe kutigera nnywa amazi yabujijwe, yamara n’itonde rimwe ryacitse ku minwa yanje, ni ukuvuga icaha cari giteye ubwoba umutima wanje ibihe bidahera.
Allah yarangeneye guhura n’umwungere akiri muto umusi umwe azoba inkuru z’imigani kubera kwica umwansi w’inkomezi.
Igihe ingabo zarwana, sinaguye ku kuboko kw’umwansi, ahubwo naguye ku itegeko ry’Imana nk’igihano c’ukutumvira kwanje ku ruzi.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
